positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked on Session Smart Routing (SSR)/128 Technology (128T) group Solutions team: creating and testing customer-like environments to test new features, enhancements, and product performance
• Delivered on high priority project to transition to new network traffic generator (Ixia-c) and reduce testing time of every SSR software release while reducing need for capital expenditure by hundreds of thousands of dollars
• Created and developed a custom Ixia-c object-oriented library using Python enabling organization to easily choose between open source traffic generators
• Enhanced Ansible and Terraform automation infrastructure running on CentOS to utilize an open source, Docker
container-based, network traffic generator called Ixia-c in Jenkins pipelines
• Wrote a Robot test suite utilizing the new Ixia-c library to send and verify traffic through SSR
• Utilized OpenStack for dynamic deployment of virtual machines for development and testing
positions.insights: Skills: Robot · Terraform · Software Infrastructure · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · CentOS · OpenStack · Docker · Python (Programming Language) · Ansible · Jenkins

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
• Worked for ONCE Animal Lighting group to automate the sharing of data between ONCE systems and Signify Interact IoT platform
• Designed and programmed lightweight prototype application to intuitively write ‘lighting recipes’ to be uploaded to the Interact Agriculture application
• Reduced the time to write complex recipes from hours to minutes
• Developed application using Python with Tkinter GUI framework along with a Model View Controller architecture
• Worked closely with scientists to understand complex scientific processes in order to implement logic in application
• Utilized encryption techniques in application to securely send data to the Interact Agriculture application
• Trusted to make major design choices, resulting in a lightweight, cross-platform, and maintainable application

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Member of SSR/128T group CAMP (Cloud, Analytics, Monitoring, Plugins) team
• Successfully automated recursive dependency resolution check for the development of plugins to the Juniper SSR
• Made significant business impact as any missing dependencies will now be caught during development ensuring successful client demonstrations of new plugins
• Exposed to full development cycles and software engineering fundamentals in first professional software engineering experience
positions.insights: Skills: Git · RPM · .NET Framework · Groovy · GitHub · Programming · DNF · CentOS · Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · Docker Products · Jenkins · Data Structures · YUM

positions.title: Undergraduate Course Assistant
positions.description:
• COMPSCI220 Programming Methodology
• Held office hours involving reading and understanding code written by students
• Led discussion section which involved presenting previous week’s material and presenting/solving problems
• Worked directly with professors in designing rubrics for specific exam questions
